brand_world.positioning: Narrative editorial digital products rooted in the identity of places, not generic tourism.
brand_world.core_logic: Every product must connect a real place, a distinctive local element, a cultural use/ritual/function, and an atmosphere or narrative frame.

permanent_lenses.name: Mobility
permanent_lenses.definition: How people, goods, and memory move through a place.

permanent_lenses.name: Built Place
permanent_lenses.definition: Architecture, settlements, streets, facades, and landscape-made spaces.

permanent_lenses.name: Table & Food
permanent_lenses.definition: Food culture, recipes, local rituals, markets, and shared table traditions.

permanent_lenses.name: Work & Craft
permanent_lenses.definition: Manual work, local trades, workshops, farming, fishing, and material culture.

permanent_lenses.name: Routes & Maps
permanent_lenses.definition: Paths, roads, districts, pilgrim routes, trade routes, neighborhood diagrams, and orientation systems.

permanent_lenses.name: Objects & Symbols
permanent_lenses.definition: Locally meaningful everyday objects, signage, tools, packaging, motifs, and symbolic forms.

output_rules.if_uncertain: use explicit uncertainty fields instead of invented facts
output_rules.if_incomplete: set status to needs_revision and list missing items
output_rules.empty_data: use empty arrays instead of fabricating content
